name: nocturne
description: NOCTURNE — web-only, GPU-accelerated, audio-reactive generative particle experience (slot 8). A GPGPU curl-noise field of ~262k particles breathing with music, rendered with cinematic post-processing in a sovereign dark-cinematic UI. Animation: R3F + drei + @react-three/postprocessing (single family) with custom GLSL; no GSAP, no Motion. See DECISIONS.md ADR-001..ADR-004.
